objective: Review the scoped process-to-launcher CLI execution boundary after accepted fixture metadata and decide whether a future run gate may start src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py from exact reviewed argv without treating this review as execution, compare, timing, or direct Verilator sidecar evidence.

review_decision.reason: The boundary is narrow enough for a first process-to-launcher CLI run attempt because it starts from reviewed process-to-launcher fixture metadata, requires the exact structured run_hybrid_template.py argv for pulp_ita_mha 64x1, preserves explicit sidecar context and source authority, and keeps coverage_output_equivalence as the only future compare policy.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still review-only. It does not start the launcher, execute sidecar stages, record native-path compare, or measure timing. The strongest remaining risk is that the future run may stop at launcher_cli_invocation_failure or sidecar_stage_failure before any compare evidence exists.
accepted_because: the source definition is explicitly definition-only
the eligible input is limited to reviewed process-to-launcher CLI fixture metadata
the launcher argv is structured and exactly names python3, src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py, config/slice_launch_templates/pulp_ita_mha.json, --shape, and 64x1
the launcher command role remains materialized_for_later_run_not_invoked_by_fixture until the next run gate
the run scope remains pulp_ita_mha, config/slice_launch_templates/pulp_ita_mha.json, and 64x1
the predecessor structured invocation run review is reference evidence but not standalone execution authority
coverage_output_equivalence is the accepted compare policy and raw full-state equality remains out of scope
generated reports and artifacts remain noncanonical evidence

required_next_gate.name: run_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_process_to_launcher_cli_execution_gate

whether sidecar stages execute after launcher invocation
whether coverage-output compare is reached from the native path
the exact failure class if the chain stops
all generated reports and artifacts as noncanonical evidence

process-to-launcher CLI runtime execution by this review gate
native-path coverage-output compare by this review gate
